architecture_envelope_effects.effect: All three options use the manufacturer TC33X-2 drawing and same family footprint already present; nominal package envelope delta is zero relative to existing TC33X-2 1k/10k references. This does not certify the provisional footprint. Preserve all pads, poses and copper.
architecture_envelope_effects.risk: Body axis, centroid, seating and B.Cu transforms need aligned comparison; rectangle dimensions alone cannot prove clearances.

architecture_envelope_effects.effect: Reserve actual top tool approach to every back-face trim, keeping 1.7 mm cross-slot engagement and force below 4.9 N. Drawing envelope does not include driver shaft, hand access, harness sweep or adjacent plane clearance.
architecture_envelope_effects.change_if_failed: Report measured conflicts; wider/taller alternatives or remote adjustment require separate review, fixed panel remains unchanged.

architecture_envelope_effects.effect: 20k total spans 15k–25k, 50k 37.5k–62.5k and 500k 375k–625k. Endpoint maximum scales with actual total. Do not assume exact 0–nominal range or that the intended calibration target is reachable.

Supplier identity can be observed, but retained raw order-page bytes, allocation, JLC assembly eligibility, lot/lifecycle confirmation and installed process evidence remain absent. Reflow/flux/cleaning cautions require assembly process review.
